title: HMI Price in Pakistan 2026 — Human Machine Interface, Touchscreen Operator Panel & SCADA Display Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete 2026 buyer guide for HMI (Human Machine Interface) panels in Pakistan. Covers 4.3-inch to 21.5-inch touchscreen operator panels, WAPDA brownout-rated power supplies, MODBUS RTU/TCP and PROFIBUS communication, pricing in PKR for home use, textile mills, sugar mills, water treatment and WAPDA substation applications. Updated August 2026.
